newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares resume advance after slow start.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares resume advance after slow start.

text.p: 1315 GMT - Austria's ATX index overcame a lacklustre start on Monday to end two percent up at a fresh closing high.
Market participants traced the bulk of the gains to strong international leads.
Carton-board manufacturer Mayr-Melnhof jumed 10 percent to 788 schillings after the issue of a "buy" recommendation, traders said.
Bank Austria shares were heavily traded in the wake of strong half-year earnings.
* ATX index up 28.83 points, or 2.01 pct, at 1,464.13.
* Leading gainer Mayr-Melnhof, up 10.52 percent at 788 ats
* Leading decliner VA Stahl, down 0.66 percent at 605 ats
* Bank Austria preferred up 1.8 ats at 439.8 ats. Creditanstalt preferred up 12.8 at 578 ats, ordinaries up 43 ats at 894.
* August ATX future up 31 points at 1,470 on 879 contracts.
